types.description: S202M-C2 miniature circuit breaker, two poles, C characteristic, 2 A

document.title: ABB System pro M compact catalogue

modelingNotes: S1 exact order selection row: printed 2/38. S202 family diagram on 11/2 establishes 1-2 and 3-4 poles and mechanical ganging; both pages visually reviewed.

Rated current 2 A. IEC/EN 60898-1: 400 V AC, Icn 10 kA; C tripping reference temperature 30 deg C. Voltage is documented capability, not an assigned supply. Alternate standard and DC ratings are not encoded.
Each numbered node includes its twin conductor/busbar terminal portions. Shared connection policy does not assert unlimited conductor capacity. No separate mating connector contacts.
Bare breaker only; mountable auxiliary/signal contacts and releases are separate accessories. No PE, shield or communication terminals. No permanent links across switched poles.

Open is the diagram reference state, not an assertion of installed switch position. Ganging and breaker symbols do not simulate tripping or create continuity. Connections remain application-dependent.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four numbered electrical terminal nodes of the bare two-pole breaker are covered. Twin entry portions share their numbered node. Separately fitted accessories are excluded; no PE, shield, signal or communication connections.
